lines.say: Why do you feel so happy after a workout?
Why does this happen, number seventeen.
For years, people credited endorphins. But endorphins are too big to easily get into your brain from your blood.
Newer studies point to endocannabinoids. Your body makes these feel-good chemicals during exercise, and they reach your brain easily.
In one study, mice that couldn't use them didn't get the calm feeling after running.
And in people, blocking endorphins didn't stop the good mood.
Moderate, steady effort works great. You don't need to destroy yourself.
Even a brisk walk lifts your mood.
